# Audiofy

> Audiofy is a free music app for Android that puts JioSaavn and YouTube in one search and one player, with time-synced lyrics, offline downloads, smart autoplay and shared playlists. No ads, no subscription, no account. This repository hosts the official APK releases.

Latest version: 1.3.2. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. Package name: com.audiofy.app.audiofy. Android only for now. Audiofy is an independent app and is not affiliated with JioSaavn or YouTube.

## Download

- [Latest release](https://github.com/Crylord-zx/audiofy-releases/releases/latest): release notes and SHA-256 hashes for every file
- [Download for modern phones (arm64)](https://github.com/Crylord-zx/audiofy-releases/releases/latest/download/audiofy-arm64-v8a.apk): about 30 MB, works on nearly every phone from the last several years
- [Download for older 32-bit phones](https://github.com/Crylord-zx/audiofy-releases/releases/latest/download/audiofy-armeabi-v7a.apk): about 28 MB
- [All releases](https://github.com/Crylord-zx/audiofy-releases/releases)

## Key facts

- Free, no ads, no in-app purchases, no account
- Searches JioSaavn and YouTube together
- Synced lyrics in the original language, Hinglish, Hindi or English, with shareable lyric cards
- Offline downloads saved with cover and lyrics
- Blend: mix two people's taste into one playlist with a link or QR code
- Daily Mixes, Discover Weekly and autoplay that learns from skips
- Four player designs, several looks, and a sound engine with equalizer and reverb
- Background playback with notification and lock-screen controls
- Games: Antakshari and a music quiz
- Not available on the Play Store; installed from an APK, so Android shows an unknown app prompt
